description: Accept or reject a likeness photo and/or correct its labels (shot, setting, mood, clothing, quality, is_person). AI photos are used in designs only after acceptance; marking is_person false moves the image out of the likeness set (never deleted). Without photo_id, pass set to change the creator's defaults: signature_mark_url, signoff_arrangement or signoff_cutout_url (values from include='identity' only).

labels.description: Partial labels to merge, e.g. { shot: 'candid', setting: 'coffee shop' }.

set.description: Change identity defaults instead of a photo.

name: bamf.update_likeness_photo
